_comment: A SHAPE, not an actuator. Placeholders throughout — see robot.template.json.
The field worth staring at is continuous_torque_nm: it is null here, and it will be null
for most real hobby servos too, because datasheets publish stall torque instead. Null is the
honest answer and it makes capacity underivable. Do not fill it in with a fraction of stall
torque; how_determined exists to reject that (ADR-0004).
note: backlash_rad is absent rather than 0. Absent means UNKNOWN; writing 0 because nobody measured it is the invented-data failure in miniature.
